log.reason_header_invalid: invalid token in the X-CSRF-Token header
log.reason_not_a_form: no token, and the body is not a form
log.reason_form_mismatch: form: the token sent is not the session's (expired session, or page opened before a sign-in)
log.reason_form_missing: form: no token in the body nor in X-CSRF-Token
log.reason_admin_login_missing: admin sign-in: no token in the form
log.reason_admin_login_mismatch: admin sign-in: the token sent is not the session's
log.reason_upload: upload: a file arrived before a valid csrf_token field — nothing was written
log.token_dropped: csrf token dropped (sign-in or sign-out): pages opened before now hold a dead one
log.token_new: new csrf token for this session
log.read_token: read the CSRF token from the session
log.keep_token: keep the CSRF token in the session
log.read_account: read the signed-in account for the CSRF token
log.write_token: write a new CSRF token to the session
log.set_value: set_value [csrf token received — its check is on the middleware.csrf channel]
